scope: Arms and fixed hands only. All 40 non-arm collision geoms retain exact source definitions and contact masks. This refinement removes redundant wrist-roll proxies and fits rounded hand capsules to native Astro meshes.
supersedes: The prior whole-body 27-collider experiment and six-proxy-per-arm revision; current geometry keeps all non-arm colliders and uses five proxies per arm.
contact_policy: Original non-arm automatic contacts preserved. Optimized arm masks are zero and scene_simplified.xml declares selected arm contact pairs.
preserved: All body/inertial/joint/passive/numerical properties and all 37 visual meshes/colors
Complete source non-arm collider definitions, including names, shapes, transforms, RGBA, groups and masks
Original default/articulated model files, source evidence, assets and previews
limitations: No measured runtime speedup or hardware contact calibration is claimed.
Merged forearm/pitch proxies retain the source collision envelope and can contact earlier than narrower source shaft segments.
The rounded hand proxy conservatively encloses native mesh vertices; its circular cross-section adds empty volume beside the palm. Mesh-vertex coverage is not a surface-area metric.
No MJX runtime, PD/controller, URDF or Workbench support is introduced.

arm_colliders.name: left_shoulder_housing_collision
arm_colliders.rationale: Preserves original transverse shoulder housing; no inflated radius beside torso.

arm_colliders.name: left_upper_arm_collision
arm_colliders.rationale: Merges collinear original shoulder shaft and yaw-axis-invariant upper-arm shaft; source radius .035 becomes .037 for distal segment.

arm_colliders.name: left_forearm_collision
arm_colliders.rationale: Distal endpoint extends from .075 to .09 m. Together with the wrist-pitch proximal sphere this contains the removed wrist-roll shell at every wrist orientation.

arm_colliders.name: left_wrist_pitch_collision
arm_colliders.rationale: One capsule contains both original wrist-pitch capsules, in the same wrist-pitch frame.

arm_colliders.name: left_wrist_hand_collision
arm_colliders.rationale: G1-inspired rounded capsule fitted to Astro native-hand mesh bounds, with mirrored lateral offset and upward palm offset. Wrist-yaw attachment preserves the rigid hand frame.

verification.wrist_roll_union: Axially symmetric cross-section check against forearm and wrist-pitch proximal sphere; articulated pose checks also performed.
verification.hand_mesh: Local-frame native mesh bounds and capsule distances recorded with the verification receipt; all retained hand vertices lie inside the new capsule.
verification.shoulder_yaw_merge: Source upper-arm capsule is collinear with shoulder yaw; retained merged shaft remains invariant under that rotation.
verification.wrist_hand_merge: Fixed hand and yaw housing follow wrist-yaw; wrist-pitch remains an independent proxy.

wrist_hand_refinement.use: Rounded fixed-hand capsule concept only; Astro dimensions and offsets are measured from its own unchanged visual meshes.
wrist_hand_refinement.removed_shell_coverage: In the elbow frame, forearm capsule radius .054 and endpoint x=.09 plus the wrist-pitch proximal sphere at x=.161/radius .045 contain the removed wrist-roll capsule (axis x=.120..141, radius .034), independent of wrist orientation.
wrist_hand_refinement.tradeoff: Centerline shortens from .118 to .100 m and aspect ratio becomes rounder. Total x extent grows from .178 to .220 m to include Astro actual extended fingers rather than retaining the undersized prior shaft.
